title: Button prompt names
description: ui/common/prompts.yaml of the game pack: the text button prompts show for each control (docs/architecture/ui.md). The engine names the control (key:enter, gamepad:south); the text the player sees is here.

keys.description: Keyboard keys by the engine's name.

mouse.description: Mouse buttons by the engine's name.

gamepad.description: Gamepad controls named alike on every family (sticks, d-pad, triggers).

families.description: Per gamepad family (generic, xbox, playstation, nintendo...), the controls each names its own way (face buttons by position, start, back, shoulders).
